free_tier.stated: anonymous guest read of 0 root entries; no account and no payment

per_object_cap.stated: the upstream provider's cap; the instance publishes none

retention.stated: until the operator's account or tenant fails; no TTL and no notice

egress.terms: served through nginx; the reader pays nothing

tooling: the AList/OpenList REST surface (/api/fs/list, /api/fs/get, /api/fs/put) and the WebDAV endpoint at /dav; the rclone alist backend speaks the REST
chaining: a fetch substrate: point a cache and two mirrors at it, never a write tier

identity_cost.detail: no registration; /api/me returns a guest session

reliability_note: Anonymous JSON listing of 2 root directories returned by the AList API on a fresh probe; guest session with permission 0; the instance still flaps between API and non-API answers.

evidence.proved: HTTP 200, JSON carrying a code field, site_title '七喵的宝藏'
an anonymous GET /api/fs/list returns a success JSON body with two root directory entries
the read path now returns an anonymous listing of two root directories
the session is anonymous: /api/me returns a guest user with permission 0 and no account requirement
the host answers the AList settings API with title 七喵的宝藏
the anonymous listing body carries the write flag true

notes: Answered as an AList API in one run and as a non-API in another, and never returned a listing. Unclassifiable at this sample size.
